title: Index of Advertisers Page Locations
description: Human-reviewed PDF page locations of the Index of Advertisers for each issue of a magazine. Sourced from the trains_magazine_extractor review pipeline.

issues.description: Map from issue date (YYYY-MM) to IOA location data.

pdf_page_numbers.description: 1-based PDF page indices containing the Index of Advertisers. May be multiple pages when the index spans several pages. Empty array when no_ioa is true.

no_ioa.description: True when a reviewer confirmed no Index of Advertisers exists in this issue.
